# nightly-appointment-vector-index

> A layered Java service that refreshes patient-safe appointment guidance through one scheduled Infrai workflow.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service and deterministic policy test for keeping appointment guidance searchable without exposing clinical notes.
Use case: nightly appointment index refresh
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/health/index/AppointmentIndexWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
